The reference is generated from the public signatures and docblocks in `src/`. [Functions and methods](functions.qmd) lists every entry, and each reference page lists its entries in the page's table of contents.

| Page | Contents |
| --- | --- |

| [Scales and guides API](reference-scales.qmd) | scales, limits, guides, color schemes, and label formatters |
| [Coordinates, facets, and composition API](reference-facets.qmd) | coordinate systems, `facetWrap()`, `facetGrid()`, and `Compose` |
| [Labels and themes API](reference-themes.qmd) | titles, axis labels, captions, themes, and the chart size |
| [Interaction API](reference-interaction.qmd) | tooltips, pan and zoom, brushing, highlighting, and parameters |
| [Output API](reference-output.qmd) | specifications, HTML, static export, and the escape hatches into raw Vega-Lite |
| [Statistics API](reference-statistics.qmd) | coefficient plots, diagnostics, predictions, marginal means, and posterior intervals |
